title: Shopify vs WooCommerce: Which Store Platform Fits You?
h1: Shopify vs WooCommerce: which store platform fits you?
description: Shopify and WooCommerce compared for a new online store: setup, costs, flexibility, maintenance, apps and plugins, and which developer to hire.
intro: Shopify and WooCommerce are two of the most common ways to run an online store. Shopify is a hosted platform: you pay a subscription and it handles hosting, security and checkout. WooCommerce is a free plugin that turns a WordPress site into a store on your own hosting. Both can work very well; the right choice depends on how much control you want and how much maintenance you are willing to handle.

faq.q: Which is easier for a beginner?
faq.a: Shopify is usually easier, because hosting and updates are handled for you.
The plugin is free, but hosting, themes, extensions and maintenance cost money.

faq.q: Can I move from one to the other later?
faq.a: Yes, products and customers can usually be migrated, but it takes planning and work.
WooCommerce offers more freedom, while Shopify offers enough for most stores within its themes.

faq.q: Do I need a developer for either?
faq.a: Not always for a simple store, but a specialist helps with setup, design and integrations.
